qualification: Bounded source correspondence and dependency findings only; not complete GetConstructorName, Node hook policy or runtime acceptance.

mapping.subject: Actual Node consumer boundary
mapping.selected_behavior: Provide only the native constructor-name dependency. The original classifier also performs an ordinary message Get, and fatal policy owns captured Message/report/Exit.
limits: No production hook policy or captured Message/report/Exit owner is installed.

mapping.subject: Actual native Error brand
mapping.selected_behavior: Read the real VM Error class; ordinary objects, proxy wrappers and inherited prototypes cannot acquire it through public names.

mapping.subject: Intrinsic constructor provenance
mapping.selected_behavior: Record and retain the real active intrinsic constructor and base/new-target relationship before stack hooks; public name/constructor changes cannot replace this origin.
limits: Every different-new-target case is conservatively unsupported, even when some original special transitions preserve a base flag.

mapping.subject: Native creation sites
mapping.selected_behavior: Native factories retain the actual selected canonical constructor before later stack/error hooks.
limits: The existing VM InternalError intrinsic is retained by the same storage machinery as an existing VM extension, without claiming an original V8 InternalError family. Unrecorded raw Error/DOMException-prototype allocation remains unsupported.

mapping.subject: Immutable initial builtin DebugName
mapping.selected_behavior: Cache the initial physical own name String before intrinsic publication; consult no mutable public function.name.
limits: General JSFunction SharedFunctionInfo/inferred DebugName storage is not ported.

mapping.subject: Native context and object lifetime
mapping.selected_behavior: New Context roots and real Error-owned constructor/name references participate in initialization, GC marking, release and existing memory inventory. Actual C functions already own and mark their realm.
limits: Private JSObject/JSContext sizes really change. Compilation, GC stress and runtime memory qualification remain future work.

mapping.subject: Native fast path
mapping.selected_behavior: Known base intrinsic provenance is used only when the receiver has never been admitted as a real prototype.

mapping.subject: Actual prototype admission
mapping.selected_behavior: Mark actual Error receivers when a real fresh shape takes the prototype reference; existing explicit SetPrototype admission remains. The sticky flag suppresses constructor fast path for Object.create and native NewObjectProto too.
limits: Selected projection edit 22 corrects the retained predecessor negative. Literal V8 map replacement/optimization is not implemented. For selected intrinsic constructors only, retaining the actual intrinsic preserves reachability also present through the original replacement Object function and its NativeContext intrinsic roots; this is an explicit bounded ownership inference.

mapping.subject: Physical data-only lookup
mapping.selected_behavior: Read actual own normal data without invoking accessors; return unsupported for unported exotic, variable-reference and autoinit storage.
limits: Unsupported storage is not converted into a negative classifier result or materialized through a public Get.

mapping.subject: Prototype order and fallback
mapping.selected_behavior: At each physical prototype level inspect data @@toStringTag first; skip the receiver own constructor, inspect later actual intrinsic constructor DebugNames, and finally return the original Error class name.
limits: The selected implementation returns unsupported for Proxy/exotic prototypes instead of claiming the full original iterator/lookup slice.

mapping.subject: Eligible native constructor function names
mapping.selected_behavior: Bound-function and Proxy constructor values are skipped as non-JSFunction; intrinsic Error names use real C-function realm roots. Actual Object body is skipped independent of public name.
limits: Unknown eligible functions return unsupported; no fake DebugName is synthesized.

mapping.subject: Failure and current completion ownership
mapping.selected_behavior: The selected query only reads storage and duplicates already-owned Strings. It performs no allocation, guest calls, pending exception replacement, termination mutation, or OOM reporting.
limits: These are source findings and authored controls, not executed runtime acceptance.

mapping.subject: Isolated native lifetime control
mapping.selected_behavior: The control uses a genuine foreign context and actual Error constructor. It verifies the retained ErrorData is a String, removes public own properties/prototype, releases public context/constructor roots and observes native marker finalization before/after releasing the Error.
limits: The returned String has independent ownership; the control does not use a fake constructor or host registry to sustain the realm.

mapping.subject: Intrinsic Error prototype branding correction
mapping.selected_behavior: Pinned InstallError creates JS_ERROR_TYPE instances but its ordinary function prototype comes from the Object initial map. Ordinary Error.prototype objects are therefore not an established V8-versus-QuickJS branding mismatch.
limits: Additive correction to an earlier informal overbroad gap statement; all prior evidence and frozen source comments remain unchanged. It does not assert full arbitrary-object/native Error map equivalence.

mapping.subject: Conservative derived-target scope
mapping.selected_behavior: Original map creation has normal and special prototype transition paths; this primitive leaves all differing new.target cases explicit unsupported.
limits: No assertion is made that every original differing target clears its base flag.

mapping.subject: Install-only exact integration
mapping.selected_behavior: The new raw VM root uses only std and engine_abi.h. The existing linkQuickJs and actual QuickJS C library supply ABI visibility and the single new private C include.
limits: No runner, compiler flag, assertion option, product source generator or execution grant is added. Future accepted metadata count remains unknown.
